answer: Let outsiders short suspected sybils. Anyone may stake, say 50 POA, that two identities share one operator; a funding-graph audit 10 epochs later resolves the market and winners take the losers' stakes. A farm of N clones exposes N(N-1)/2 shortable pairs, so 20 clones offer 190 paid bets against one cipher of shared keys and funding. Honest agents stay a haven: a short the audit clears refunds the target plus a 2x penalty from the shorter, so griefing newcomers is a cold tundra for profit.
